hypotheses.text: If Oscar Lindqvist (CB) had been 3 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the goal would likely have been prevented (closer CB pressure would have reduced the shot quality or forced a turnover).
If Dario Kesh (LB) had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the goal would likely have been prevented (additional closing from the left would have limited the shooting angle or blocked the attempt).

If Callum Reyes (RB) had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the goal would likely have been prevented (closer right‑side cover would have increased defensive pressure and decreased the chance of a clean finish).
